note: A second entry for countries where the media library already holds the picture — so a child meets a painted person rather than a symbol.

PER.name: Inca
PER.note: Builders of Cusco and of roads over the whole Andes.

MEX.name: Aztec
MEX.note: A city built on a lake, with floating gardens for fields.

IRL.name: Celt
IRL.note: Iron-age people of spirals, torcs and hilltop kings.

NLD.name: Volendam fisherfolk
NLD.note: Lace caps, wooden shoes, and a harbour that lost its sea.

BHS.name: Pirate
BHS.note: For a few years Nassau was run by pirates and nobody else.

FRA.name: Joan of Arc
FRA.note: A farm girl of seventeen who led an army and lifted a siege.

MNG.name: Genghis Khan
MNG.note: From one camp on the steppe to the largest land empire there has been.

GRC.name: Alexander the Great
GRC.note: Born at Pella; by thirty he had ridden as far as India.
